description: Complete game atlas of the playable area and exact 600 m source scenery ring, with four separately labelled distant context views.
coverageNote: Every 250 m grid cell intersecting the runtime playable mask or exact analytic 600 m ring is included. This describes capture coverage only; it is not a fidelity score. Boundary cells also contain land outside the source ring.
reviewNote: Complete133-frame source-bound capture and paired aerial review with recorded modelling limits and unresolved source contradictions. This is not full visual parity or a driving-budget acceptance claim.

review.status: Complete133-frame source-bound capture and paired aerial review with recorded modelling limits and unresolved source contradictions. This is not full visual parity or a driving-budget acceptance claim.
review.method: Manual visual inspection of all17private paired sheets. First120frames were reviewed during capture; all15corresponding preview sheets are byte-identical to the final sheets. Last13frames reviewed after completion. Every current image and reference hash is reconciled with the completed133pair ledger.

findings.finding: Boundary tiles include land beyond the600m source ring. The aerial continues into dense city and rail context where the game has deliberately sparse outer context; coverage does not extend the source-detail guarantee to the whole tile.

Some source-backed completed structures and paved areas occupy reference construction/excavation zones. Retain source geometry and the unknown aerial acquisition date; the reference alone cannot date the discrepancy.
Industrial/rail sidings, excavation texture, temporary stockpiles and fine yard equipment are simplified or absent. Actual source building identities remain separately audited.
Large source nursery/greenhouse bodies are present, while repetitive glass/panel/grid roof detail and yard ground texture remain simplified.
Canopy survey retains crown locations, but scrub, saplings and ground cover remain coarse; this is not a one-to-one vegetation replica.

Office source bodies and mapped openings are present. Roof plant, photovoltaic arrays, glass atrium articulation and literal facade detail remain approximate or absent; perspective roof displacement remains visible.
Mapped meadow/canopy extents are present, but scrub density, paths, fine court covers and minor land-use texture remain generalized.
Tall office and retail roofs have large perspective displacement in this216.5m camera. Rooftop technical equipment, mall skylight/panel detail and fine facade articulation are not a literal replica.
The museum aircraft source planforms are visible in their source layout. All23source identities/planforms are audited separately; vertical dimensions remain recorded estimates.
Source overpass alignment and the river crossing remain present; comparison is top-down only and does not establish driving clearance or traffic behavior.

Source lake/shore shapes are present, with simplified banks and docks. Blue water differs from the dark green reference appearance; colour, season and acquisition date are not a physical bathymetry or water-quality measurement.
The reference shows white covers over some sports courts; the game retains mapped open courts. Temporary/seasonal cover state is not resolved from an undated aerial.

Office roof plant, fine podium/courtyard surfaces and active construction detail remain simplified. Source road/building contradictions on w27750597/w176791388 and w176792203 remain separately unresolved; this atlas does not close them.

Lake edges, islands and separately mapped ponds remain present. Fine shoreline walls, shore paths, piers, yard detail and water appearance are simplified; undated aerials do not resolve seasonal bank/vegetation or construction changes.

Source lake/bridge and shoreline settlement remain present. Outer ring boundary tiles can include large areas beyond the detailed source footprint; small docks, bank paths, courtyard detail and dense garden vegetation remain simplified.

Source shoreline, small residential/office bodies, mapped sports/pool areas and road bends are visible. Roof tile/panel texture, private garden/terrace details, bank structures and occupancy remain generalized; ground beyond the600m source ring is sparse. No completeness claim is made for temporary court covers or untagged structures seen only in the reference.

Southern ring and four distant context tiles retain source-backed water and small bodies. Bank structures, parking/occupancy, small garden/cemetery detail and dense vegetation are simplified. The four outside-ring views deliberately contain sparse distant context and do not claim600m-detail fidelity.

review.limits: Private comparison only. Game is a perspective north-up ground-square capture; roofs project beyond their source footprints. Reference acquisition date, season and registration are not known. Reference images and paired sheets remain outside the checkout.

collectionNotes.atlas: 133 fresh frames on c78a5f4. High quality, summer, clear daylight; moving traffic and mirrors disabled. Source SHA and capture time are retained per frame. The atlas documents remaining modelling limits.
